features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance publication printing

items.title: Single-Pass Piezoelectric Inkjet Architecture
items.desc: Single-pass printing eliminates carriage scanning delays, enabling continuous duplex output at up to 100 m/min for books, magazines, and high-volume publication work at industrial production speeds.

items.title: Advanced Duplex Printing System
items.desc: Precision double-sided printing in a single pass delivers consistent front-to-back registration accuracy of +/- 0.5 mm, ensuring aligned, professional-quality output on every sheet without separate duplex passes.

items.title: Ultra HD Print Quality at 1200 x 600 dpi
items.desc: Maximum resolution of 1200 x 600 dpi with grayscale printing technology delivers sharp, crisp text and high-definition image reproduction suited to demanding book and magazine production standards.

items.title: Infrared Drying with Auto Energy Saving
items.desc: Smart infrared drying system automatically adjusts energy consumption based on media type and print coverage, reducing operating costs while maintaining consistent, smear-free drying at all production speeds.

items.title: Intelligent Integrated Control System
items.desc: Self-developed integrated control system manages all machine functions and production workflow from a single interface, enabling rapid job switching, real-time monitoring, and automated digital workflow management.

items.title: Flexible Media Handling System
items.desc: Supports multiple paper types and weights from 45 to 160 gsm with roll-to-roll and optional roll-to-sheet output configurations, giving publishers and print houses the flexibility to serve diverse job requirements.

items.title: Water-Based Pigment Ink Technology
items.desc: Water-based pigment inks produce high-quality, durable output with sharp text and vibrant image reproduction while supporting a cleaner, lower-emission production environment compared to solvent-based alternatives.

items.title: End-to-End Digital Workflow Integration
items.desc: Automated digital workflow management from pre-press through to finishing eliminates manual handover points, reduces setup time, and supports high-productivity short-run and variable data production.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of book, magazine, and publication applications, delivering exceptional print quality, speed, and production flexibility.

fabrics.title: Educational Book Publishers and Printers
fabrics.desc: High-speed duplex output at 100 m/min makes the VividPress-E the most productive digital solution for educational textbook publishers and book printers managing large seasonal print runs with tight delivery schedules.

fabrics.title: Commercial Book Publishers
fabrics.desc: No plate-making requirement, single-copy starting capability, and fast job switching enable commercial publishers to reduce inventory pressure and respond faster to demand with cost-efficient print-on-demand production.

fabrics.title: Newspaper and Tabloid Printers
fabrics.desc: Single-pass speed and wide media support make the VividPress-E a capable solution for newspaper and tabloid publishers moving from offset to digital production or supplementing offset capacity with digital flexibility.

fabrics.title: Transactional and Data-Driven Print Operations
fabrics.desc: Variable data printing capability and automated workflow management suit high-volume transactional document printers producing statements, reports, forms, and personalised communications at industrial output rates.

fabrics.title: Government and Institutional Printers
fabrics.desc: Reliable, high-speed duplex output with consistent quality supports government print departments, institutional publishers, and large in-plant print operations requiring high-volume document and publication printing.

fabrics.title: Magazines and Periodical Publishers
fabrics.desc: High-resolution duplex colour output on standard coated offset media makes the VividPress-E a practical choice for magazine and periodical publishers requiring quality, speed, and production flexibility.

fabrics.title: Print-on-Demand and Short-Run Production
fabrics.desc: No minimum run requirement, zero plate cost, and rapid job changeover make the VividPress-E the ideal platform for print-on-demand services managing high volumes of short-run and variable jobs simultaneously.
